verdict.rationale: Gecko documents a v1 API, backed by a published OpenAPI spec, that covers the core workflow: triggering scans, reading scan, repository and vulnerability data, triaging findings, managing schedules, rotating the GitLab token, and webhooks. Its MCP server also lets AI tools file tickets. However, several documented UI actions have no stated API equivalent, so full parity is not shown. missing for 10: an API for Request fix / fix-PR creation, an API for repository and provider connection and PR-check configuration, an API for API-key and team management, an explicit API–UI parity statement, and independent hands-on corroboration of API coverage.
